subject: MAP: evaluation runway and procurement lead times for Dedicated GPU pool
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Eric Wang <eric.wang@stellardata.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: evaluation runway and procurement lead times for Dedicated GPU pool

Hi Eric —

Thanks again for the time today. As discussed, I drafted a compact Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that aligns the evaluation milestones with the procurement/commitment timeline so you can see where Dedicated vs Private options fit. High-level items I want to capture up front:

- Evaluation sprint (3 weeks): perf runs at your representative 3k-token workload, latency SLOs, and cost-per-token baseline.
- Contract & procurement: procurement review + PO issuance (typical Stellar lead time ~4–8 weeks) — we should align dates now to avoid a cliff.
- Dedicated pool sizing: our preliminary estimate is 6–8 A100-equivalent GPUs for baseline, scale to 12 if you plan sustained throughput > 3M tokens/day. Exact sizing depends on concurrency, QPS, and KV-cache hit-rate.
- Private on-prem: if you choose private (on-prem), hardware lead times and logistics add ~8–12 weeks after PO. VPC-hosted private option reduces delivery to ~4–6 weeks.

I attached a short MAP draft (Stellar-MAP-v1.pdf) and an eval test plan for your engineering team to review. Can you confirm:
1) Target go-live quarter? (Q4 or later?)
2) Procurement cadence/any existing purchase windows we should respect?
3) Who on your side will own the PoC performance sign-off?

If procurement prefers a staggered commit (start with smaller Dedicated pool + burst capacity) we can reflect that in the MAP and reduce initial CAPEX.

Next steps on our side: Marissa will scope the acceptance criteria and Ben will run a sizing model with your sample workload once we get the test data.

Thanks — looking forward to locking dates so we can match capacity and shipping windows.

Best,
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
pri...@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0182

Attachment: Stellar-MAP-v1.pdf (application/pdf)
Attachment: eval-test-plan.csv (text/csv)

From: Eric Wang <eric.wang@stellardata.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: Anika Rao <anika.rao@stellardata.com>, Stellar Data Procurement <procurement@stellardata.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 11:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: evaluation runway and procurement lead times for Dedicated GPU pool

Thanks Priyom — this looks helpful. A few quick answers:

1) Target go-live: mid-November looks realistic for the feature roadmap, so Q4 start is preferred.
2) Procurement cadence: we have two windows — mid-September and late-October. If we miss mid-September review, approval will likely be pushed to the October window. Procurement lead is CC'd (procurement@stellardata.com).
3) Performance sign-off: Anika Rao (cc) will own PoC acceptance, but our infra team will run the perf lab runs; they will need the eval test plan and a sample data batch.

Questions from infra team: can Redwood provide a short-lived evaluation license for a Dedicated pool (isolated tenant) rather than multi-tenant hosted? Also need clarification on what you mean by "A100-equivalent" — are you sizing for 80GB A100 or using smaller but more numerous cards (e.g., 8xA40-style)?

Procurement: please send standard SOW and any SOC2 evidence pointers early — procurement wants to see compliance docs before the September window.

—Eric

On Tue, Aug 10, 2026 at 09:12 AM Priyom Das <pri...@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Eric —
> ...

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Eric Wang <eric.wang@stellardata.com>, Priyom Das <pri...@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 08:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: evaluation runway and procurement lead times for Dedicated GPU pool

Eric / team —

Thanks for the clear set of windows. A few operational clarifications so the MAP is actionable:

- Evaluation license: we can provision a short-lived Dedicated evaluation pool (isolated tenant) for a 3-week PoC. That will include per-route observability and token-level cost breakdowns. We'll send credentials and the eval cluster URL once you approve the MAP.

- GPU SKU clarification: our sizing note used "A100-equivalent" as shorthand. For your targets, Ben will run two concrete configs and show expected latency/cost:
  * 2x 80GB A100 nodes (higher-perf, lower-concurrency)
  * 8x A40-style 48GB nodes (higher-concurrency, lower per-node perf)
He'll include throughput estimates at 100ms/200ms/300ms median latencies.

- Procurement docs: Priyom, I'll attach the SOW template and SOC2 pointer in the MAP v1 -> v2 update. Also we should propose a staggered commit option: start with 4 A100-eq and add a tranche at mid-Q1 if usage grows as forecasted.

Operational ask for Stellar: can you share the sample batch (1–2GB) and a short list of representative prompts by EOD Thu (Aug 14)? That lets Ben run the sizing worksheet and produce a recommended initial commit.

If September procurement review is realistic, we need a locked SOW and pricing by Aug 24 to hit that window. Otherwise we target the October window.

I'll loop in Laura for legal/contract cadence — she'll confirm DocuSign timelines.

-Marissa

Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Solutions | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachment: gpu-sizing-estimate.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Priyom Das <pri...@redwood.com>
To: Eric Wang <eric.wang@stellardata.com>, Anika Rao <anika.rao@stellardata.com>, Stellar Data Procurement <procurement@stellardata.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Aug 2026 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: evaluation runway and procurement lead times for Dedicated GPU pool

Eric / Anika / Procurement team —

Appreciate the quick responses and the procurement windows — that helps a lot. Action items captured below and attached updated MAP (v2) with explicit milestone dates to hit the mid-September review:

1) Stellar to provide sample batch + representative prompts — ETA: Thu Aug 14 (Anika).
2) Redwood to provision Dedicated eval pool (3-week) — target start Mon Aug 17.
3) Ben to deliver sizing worksheet with 2 SKU scenarios by Tue Aug 18.
4) Draft SOW & pricing sent to procurement for mid-September review — Laura to send Docusign-ready SOW by Aug 21.
5) If procurement confirms mid-September window and PO issued within that window, VPC-hosted Private delivery target: 4–6 weeks from PO (estimated mid-Oct). On-prem Private hardware adds 8–12 additional weeks.

I attached MAP-v2 which includes the staggered-commit option and acceptance criteria (perf thresholds, request traces, and cost baseline). Please review and reply-all with any edits to milestone dates. If procurement prefers the October window, we will adjust the MAP and provide alternate rollout phases.

Thanks — will follow up Monday with the eval cluster URL once credentials are ready.

Best,
Priyom
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Stellar-MAP-v2.pdf (application/pdf), eval-test-plan.csv (text/csv)
